name: @intent-harness/api
description: Python API. Package scripts wrap uv so Turborepo can orchestrate it; uv owns Python dependencies.

scripts.lint: uv run --frozen ruff check . && uv run --frozen ruff format --check .
scripts.format: uv run --frozen ruff format . && uv run --frozen ruff check --fix .
scripts.test: uv run --frozen coverage run -m pytest && uv run --frozen coverage json -q && uv run --frozen python scripts/check_coverage.py
